tools.name: search_businesses
tools.description: Search the directory of independent workers and small businesses in Costa Rica (gardeners, painters, plumbers, electricians, cleaners, bakers, mechanics and more). Results are ranked by customer rating, then by number of reviews. Pass a free-text query ("panadera", "plumber"), optionally a category

tools.name: get_business
tools.description: Full public profile of one worker or business: about, services, service area, how to contact them (phone, WhatsApp, email, website, social pages), payment methods, rating and a link to the page. Give the slug from search_businesses.

tools.name: get_business_reviews
tools.description: Customer reviews of one profile, newest first (rating, text, date, first name and initial). Reviews are written by signed-in users; the directory does not verify that the reviewer hired the person.

tools.name: top_rated
tools.description: The best-rated profiles in a category, optionally in one area, ranked by average rating and then by number of reviews: the answer to "who is a good X in Y". Unrated profiles come last and say so.

tools.name: list_categories
tools.description: Every category that has at least one live profile, grouped, with the number of profiles and the slug to use in the other tools.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "public" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search_businesses, get_business, get_business_reviews · Private data: get_business · Public sink: get_business.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search_businesses, get_business, get_business_reviews · Private data: get_business · Public sink: get_business

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
